args.question: Provide the cardholder statement regarding this transaction.

args.narrative: The transaction was authorised 2026-03-01 for 7463 USD. AVS matched (Y) and CVV matched (M). The device and IP used match the cardholder device on record. Goods were delivered by USPS on 2026-03-04. The cardholder has prior undisputed transactions on the account.

args.explanation: Read the case at inquiry stage (fraud, 4837). Listed evidence, read AVS/CVV match (Y/M), device and IP match (matches cardholder), delivery proof (USPS 2026-03-04) and prior undisputed history. Requested the cardholder statement (does not recognise the charge). Represented on 2026-03-06 with the six documents including receipt and authorization record; the inquiry resolved in the merchant favour with 0 refunded.
